params.call_sequence: cc.build_galerkin_matrix(c, N, T, dps) -> cc.compute_ground_state(Q) -> cc.extract_zeros(vec, n_zeros, dps, c); mirrors O8_weil_inner_product.py
params.spectral_gap_method: the package exposes no public accessor for the second eigenvalue; this script replicates connes_cvs operator.py:684-694's own V_even projector, forms Q_even = V_even^T Q V_even, and calls mp.eigsy on that same matrix (the same call the package makes at operator.py:697). The replication is checked every run against the lambda the package returned
params.bridge_coordinate: d = 2*log2(c) - 1, from lambda = 2^((d+1)/2); the axis O19_bridge_figure.py uses
params.precision: mixed: connes_cvs arbitrary precision at mp.dps = 150 for the Galerkin matrix, the even-sector eigensolve and the zero extraction (flint Arb backend when connes_cvs.operator.HAS_FLINT, see gate A; flint working precision is int(3.5*dps) by the package's default); full-precision decimal strings kept in *_str fields; float64 in the plain numeric fields and in every printed table

constants.connes_reference: A. Connes, 'The Riemann Hypothesis: Past, Present and a Letter Through Time', arXiv:2602.04022v1, 3 Feb 2026
constants.connes_open_question_section_5: What we do not know is that, when we increase the upper limit, which was x = 13 here, the corresponding set of zeros will converge towards the zeros of zeta. This is something which at this point is not proved.
constants.connes_missing_hypothesis_section_6_6: one needs to show that the smallest eigenvalue of the Weil quadratic form QW_lambda is simple with even eigenvector
constants.theorem_6_1_hypothesis: Theorem 6.1 (Connes & van Suijlekom) puts the zeros on the critical line PROVIDED the smallest eigenvalue is simple, isolated, and has an even eigenfunction. The spectral gap measured here is the quantity that hypothesis requires
constants.o10_note: O10 is a deliberate gap in the series and is not filled by this script
constants.proves_nothing_note: this script measures; it proves nothing and interprets nothing. No verdict is stamped anywhere in it
constants.extract_zeros_record_note: extract_zeros returns a LIST OF PER-ZERO DICTS with keys k, gamma_true, gamma_detected, error, residual, converged, failure, tolerance (operator.py:779-785). Records are indexed by key; mp.mpf() is never called on a record

even_sector_replication.statement: min of the replicated even-sector spectrum equals the lambda returned by cc.compute_ground_state
even_sector_replication.api_note: connes_cvs 0.3.1 exposes no public accessor for the second eigenvalue; compute_ground_state returns only (lambda_min, v_full). This is the package's OWN projector and the package's OWN mp.eigsy call, not a different matrix

gate_a.statement: `import flint` succeeds AND connes_cvs.operator.HAS_FLINT is True
gate_a.fallback_note: when HAS_FLINT is False the digamma evaluations take the mpmath fallback and the run is roughly 2.7x slower; the run is NOT stopped

gate_b.statement: at c = 13 the smallest even-sector eigenvalue reproduces the value recorded in the O8 log to at least 6 significant figures (relative tolerance 5e-07)

parameter_difference.note: the O8 runs used N = 100, T = 800 at dps = 300 and dps = 150; this script defaults to T = 400. A mismatch under a different T is a PARAMETER MISMATCH, not a failure of the package
